description: An opaque cream floor-length gown has a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, and narrow geometric brown and gold woven trim along the neckline, sleeves, central panels, and hem. A rust-colored fringed wrap drapes along the forearms. A patterned waist sash with a round ornamental clasp and hanging tassels accompanies gold-toned earrings, wrist jewelry, rings, and open-toed leather sandals.
